title: Parameter setup
action: Define and record all physical and material parameters (a, n, D, r, h, d, D*, eta, sigma, n_D) as specified in the instruction. Write them to parameters.json for documentation.
description: Assign numerical values to all input parameters required by subsequent formulas.

title: Calculate string formation speed v
action: Compute the string growth speed v from the molecular-scale formula v = D * a^2 * h * n / r (thin string approximation h ~ r). Write the result to step_v.txt.
description: Speed of string growth on a linear generator, to be compared with the paper's estimate of ~1 cm/s.
output_schema: Plain text file containing a single floating-point number in cm/s.

title: Calculate cooperative assembly time t_SD
action: Compute the radial cooperative assembly time t_SD = h^2 / (6 * D). Write the result to step_t_SD.txt.
description: Diffusion-limited radial assembly time, used later to compute the speed threshold under cooperative assembly.
output_schema: Plain text file containing a single floating-point number in seconds.

title: Calculate strength-limited transport velocity [V]
action: Compute the maximum cell transport speed limited by string strength: [V] = [sigma] * d^2 / (D* * eta). Write the result to step_V_strength.txt.
description: Speed limit imposed by the string's breaking strength, to be compared with the paper's estimate of ~5 cm/s.
output_schema: Plain text file containing a single floating-point number in cm/s.

title: Calculate latency threshold L* (linear growth)
action: Compute L* = a * (a^{-3} / n). Write the result to step_L_star.txt.
description: Critical intercellular distance above which string-mediated linear-growth signaling is faster than diffusion. Expected order ~1e-5–1e-4 cm.
output_schema: Plain text file containing a single floating-point number in cm.

title: Calculate radial assembly speed threshold
action: Using the previously computed t_SD and the diffusion coefficient D, compute the distance threshold L_radial = sqrt(D * t_SD). Write the result to step_L_radial.txt.
description: Critical distance above which string-mediated signaling via cooperative radial assembly is faster than diffusion. Expected order ~1e-6 cm.
output_schema: Plain text file containing a single floating-point number in cm.

title: Calculate material-consumption threshold L**
action: Compute L** = d * (D* / a)^{3/2} * (32 * n_D)^{-1/2}. Write the result to step_L_dstar.txt.
description: Critical distance above which string formation uses fewer signaling molecules than diffusion. Expected order ~3e-4–1e-2 cm.
output_schema: Plain text file containing a single floating-point number in cm.
